items.title: [Fischer] Atlanta and Charlotte, league sources say, have engaged in on-and-off trade discussions on frameworks that would feature Dorian Finney-Smith and Buddy Hield. League sources say that the Hawks have been exploring potential trades that include Hield's $9.7 million salary all summer.
